row_rule: Existing stored fitting-bank order; block zero is a reproducibility anchor and seven blocks extend coverage
factor_source: Pinned checks.json: detached_fitting_statistics_live_action_route.details.factor; no recomputation or per-block fit
gradient_identity_rule: L2(error) <= atol + rtol * max(L2(left), L2(right)); scalar/array comparisons use elementwise allclose
block_coefficient: Native c from mean absolute actor Q1 on the same 32 rows; detached
full_batch_rule: Row-weighted raw Q/U/BC gradient trees averaged first; one native c from full-256 mean absolute Q applied afterward; never average norms or normalized block gradients
selection_rule: No penalty coefficient, production normalization, or checkpoint selected
heterogeneity_rule: Report valid differences between blocks; no pass/fail threshold based on preferred gradient strength or direction
limitations: This extension was fixed after observing the first-block results; it is exhaustive fitting-bank coverage, not an independent confirmation.
One frozen checkpoint and fitting rows cannot establish improved action selection, training performance or cross-environment robustness.
The fixed factor is a hypothetical dimensionless penalty-strength multiplier; at this checkpoint it is equivalent to multiplying kappa, not a necessary unit conversion.
A mean of block gradient norms or ratios is not the norm or ratio of the whole-batch gradient; report these separately.
The kappa grid derives from validated component gradients; it is not seven training runs.
BC gradient and directional cancellation remain part of the full actor objective.
The native fixed epsilon and all original scientific sources remain unchanged; near-zero Q and invalid-ready references remain explicit design concerns.
U remains a TD-residual proxy, not a Q1 value-error guarantee.
